<div class="start-bar">

  <!-- Start Menu -->
  <div id="start-menu" class="start-menu">

    </div>
    <div class="start-menu-items">
      <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="home"><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/computer-4.png" alt="">Home</a>
      <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="projects"><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/internet_options-0.png" alt="">Projects</a>
      <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="resume"><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/notepad_file-2.png" alt="">Resume</a>
      <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="publications"><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/directory_open_file_mydocs_2k-2.png" alt="">Publications</a>
      <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="music"><img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/cd_audio_cd_a-4.png" alt="">Music</a>
      <div class="start-menu-item has-submenu">
        <img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/directory_admin_tools-4.png" alt="">Utilities
        <div class="start-menu-submenu">

          <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="harmonograph">Harmonograph</a>
          <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="image-to-ascii">Image to ASCII</a>
          <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="bmg-format">BMG Format</a>
          <a class="start-menu-item" href="#" data-window="l5r-dice">L5R Dice</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="start-menu-item has-submenu">
        <img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/paint_file-4.png" alt="">Settings
        <div class="start-menu-submenu">
          <button class="start-menu-item" id="wallpaper-btn">
            <img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/display_properties-0.png" alt="">Change Wallpaper...
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <hr class="start-menu-separator">
      <button class="start-menu-item" id="shutdown-btn">
        <img src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/standby_monitor_moon-4.png" alt="">Shut Down...
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Shutdown Dialog -->
  <div id="shutdown-overlay" class="shutdown-overlay">
    <div class="window shutdown-dialog">
      <div class="title-bar">
        <div class="title-bar-text">Shut Down Windows</div>
        <div class="title-bar-controls">
          <button aria-label="Close" id="shutdown-close"></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="window-body shutdown-body">
        <p>What do you want the computer to do?</p>
        <div class="field-row">
          <input type="radio" id="sd-shutdown" name="sd-choice" value="shutdown" checked>
          <label for="sd-shutdown">Shut down</label>
        </div>
        <div class="field-row">
          <input type="radio" id="sd-restart" name="sd-choice" value="restart">
          <label for="sd-restart">Restart the computer</label>
        </div>
        <div class="shutdown-buttons">
          <button id="shutdown-ok">OK</button>
          <button id="shutdown-cancel">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Wallpaper Dialog -->
  <div id="wallpaper-overlay" class="wallpaper-overlay">
    <div class="window wallpaper-dialog">
      <div class="title-bar">
        <div class="title-bar-text">Display Properties</div>
        <div class="title-bar-controls">
          <button aria-label="Close" id="wallpaper-close"></button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="window-body wallpaper-body">
        <p><strong>Color:</strong></p>
        <div id="color-swatches" class="swatch-grid"></div>
        <p><strong>Pattern:</strong></p>
        <div id="pattern-swatches" class="swatch-grid"></div>
        <div class="shutdown-buttons">
          <button id="wallpaper-ok">OK</button>
          <button id="wallpaper-cancel">Cancel</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Safe to Turn Off Screen -->
  <div id="safe-to-off">
    <div>
      <p>It is now safe to turn off<br>your computer.</p>
      <p style="font-size:11px">(Click anywhere to continue)</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Screensaver -->
  <div id="screensaver" class="screensaver">
    <canvas id="screensaver-canvas"></canvas>
  </div>

  <!-- Start Button -->
  <button class="start-button" id="start-button">
    <img style="height:90%" src="https://win98icons.alexmeub.com/icons/png/windows-0.png" alt="">
    <strong>Start</strong>
  </button>

  <!-- Taskbar Window Buttons -->
